description: The dbdatakit console: sign-in, users and invitations, and the one web interface for the DbData servers paired with it. Needs the .NET 10 runtime (ASP.NET Core).
notes: Settings and data (the users, sessions, certificate) live in the console's data directory, away from the program files. The state database is a SQLite file in that directory (the 'service' topology, which needs no setup); for one database per group or for the whole install run: dbdatakit state init --topology group|install. Start it with: dbdatakit server run. Pair a server with it: run 'server pair' on the server, then dbdatakit instance add <url> --code <code>.
